en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a rural village landscape with fields, spotted houses, a bridge, and a church featuring a tall steeple. The foreground contains trees, while the background consists of a forested hill. The printed text at the top identifies the location as 'Stöde Edsta.' The reverse side displays handwritten correspondence in Swedish, an address, and a green postage stamp canceled in 1913.
